load_coco_json: load a COCO instances annotation JSON file into Detectron2 standard dataset dict format with bounding boxes and segmentation
load_sem_seg: load semantic segmentation ground truth images matched by file path from a directory into Detectron2 dataset dict format
convert_to_coco_json: convert a Detectron2 registered dataset into COCO JSON format and cache the output to a file on disk
convert_to_coco_dict: convert a Detectron2 registered dataset into a serializable COCO JSON dict with images, annotations, and categories
register_coco_instances: register a COCO JSON annotation dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for instance detection and segmentation
